import struct, json
data=open('trunc.db','rb').read()
assert data[0]==0x0d
ncell=int.from_bytes(data[3:5],'big')
ptrs=[int.from_bytes(data[8+2*i:10+2*i],'big') for i in range(ncell)]

def varint(b,i):
    v=0
    for k in range(9):
        c=b[i+k]
        if k==8:
            return (v<<8)|c, i+9
        v=(v<<7)|(c&0x7f)
        if not c&0x80:
            return v,i+k+1

def slen(t):
    return {0:0,1:1,2:2,3:3,4:4,5:6,6:8,7:8,8:0,9:0}.get(t, (t-12)//2 if t%2==0 else (t-13)//2)

def sval(t,b):
    if t==0: return None
    if 1<=t<=6: return int.from_bytes(b,'big',signed=True)
    if t==7: return struct.unpack('>d',b)[0]
    if t==8: return 0
    if t==9: return 1
    if t%2==0: return b.hex()
    return b.decode('utf-8','replace')

rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    plen,i=varint(data,p)
    rowid,i=varint(data,i)
    payload=data[i:i+plen]
    hlen,j=varint(payload,0)
    types=[]
    while j<hlen:
        t,j=varint(payload,j); types.append(t)
    body=hlen; vals=[]
    for t in types:
        l=slen(t); vals.append(sval(t,payload[body:body+l])); body+=l
    rows.append((rowid,vals))
rows.sort(key=lambda r:r[0])
out=[{'word':vals[1],'value':vals[2]} for _,vals in rows]
with open('recover.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(out,f)
print(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
